traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The clockwork hound is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The clockwork hound has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Diligent Tracker
traits.text: Clockwork hounds are designed to guard areas and track prey. They have advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks when tracking.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tripping Tongue
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Explosive Core
actions.text: The mechanism that powers the hound explodes when the construct is destroyed. All creatures within 5 feet of the hound take 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.
